metadata.xgboost_prediction_source: results/shared_fold/{database}_shared_fold.npz (p24 and p72; one fixed patient-grouped 5-fold partition)
metadata.alignment: All three model series are aligned on the exact common ids and checked for identical y/y3 outcomes before analysis.
metadata.estimand: Evaluation-sample uncertainty conditional on already fitted out-of-fold predictions and original folds; models are not retrained within bootstrap replicates.
metadata.correctness_distance: Absolute distance between the predicted argmax class and the final three-class outcome.
metadata.clinical_major_upgrade: Primary: any 24 h non-death prediction changing to death at 72 h. Secondary: home-to-facility and any class upgrade.

prediction_provenance.xgboost: results/shared_fold/mimic4_shared_fold.npz: one fixed patient-grouped 5-fold partition shared by all landmarks

temporal_vs_notemporal.direction: temporal penalty minus no temporal penalty

suppression_assessment.criteria: Directional suppression requires fewer new upgrades to death and more missed deaths at 72 h; simultaneous 95% CI exclusion of zero strengthens the assessment.
suppression_assessment.interpretation: Point estimates are consistent with suppression of death recognition, but the paired interval does not establish both components.

interpretation_boundary: The analysis describes stability of fitted predictions, not the effect of retraining an algorithm.
Facility is a heterogeneous destination group.
Home, facility, and death are ordinally coded for analysis; this ordering is a modelling assumption.
A lower flip rate is not sufficient evidence of better prediction.
